resources.string: Pause your music before starting. Wear your AirPods and hold your phone still at eye level. You’ll look up once, then face forward again.
Gentle vibrations will cue each movement. Keep your AirPods in throughout setup.
Keep your AirPods in and your phone steady.
Keep your head level and relaxed. Hold your phone still at eye level.
Slowly lift your chin, then hold still. Keep your phone in place. The next vibration means return to level.
Face your phone again and hold still until setup finishes.
Gently turn your head left and right. Keep this screen open while the movement check runs.
Start again when you’re ready. Keep your phone still and follow the movement cues.
The movement check has finished. Your starting settings have been restored.
The movement check couldn’t finish. Check that your AirPods are connected, then try again.
The movement check hasn’t finished closing. Go back before starting setup again.
Turn on Fixed Spatial Audio in AirPods settings, then start again.
Keep your head level and still while facing your phone at the start.
Return to the same level position you started in, then hold still.
Gently lift your chin a little farther when asked to look up.
Look straight up without turning or tilting to either side.
Check that your AirPods are connected, keep them in place, and try again.
